entries.title: Eastern Body, Western Mind
entries.author: Anodea Judith
entries.text: Anodea Judith uses the chakra system as a framework for exploring personal development and psychological experience. Each chapter considers one chakra alongside ideas drawn from Jungian psychology, body-oriented therapy and theories of childhood development. Eastern Body, Western Mind connects that spiritual framework with discussions of relationships, family patterns and identity. This revised edition presents the author's synthesis of these traditions for readers interested in psychology and spirituality, with its chapters organised around the seven chakras.
entries.identityNotes: Publisher confirms exact 9781587612251 revised edition. Describes the author's spiritual framework without presenting therapeutic or supernatural claims as established medical facts.

entries.title: In Other Lands
entries.author: Sarah Rees Brennan
entries.text: Elliot enters a magical world expecting wonders, but the school he finds puts an unwelcome emphasis on weapons and combat. Elves and mermaids interest him far more than becoming a warrior. In Other Lands follows this sarcastic, bookish outsider as he tries to make room for friendship and a less violent way of dealing with conflict. Sarah Rees Brennan's young adult fantasy uses a magical school setting to explore belonging, growing up and the possibility of peace.
entries.identityNotes: Authorized 2017 excerpt supports the school, pacifist protagonist and premise; publisher listing confirms selected hardcover ISBN 9781618731203. No paperback bonus-story claim.

entries.title: Wijsgerig misverstand
entries.author: Broer Jansma
entries.text: Broer Jansma onderzoekt hoe filosofen nadenken over kennis, werkelijkheid en de geschiedenis van de wetenschap. Wijsgerig misverstand bundelt zeven samenhangende artikelen en aanvullende essays uit zijn nalatenschap. Het idealisme en de wetenschapsleer van Karl Popper vormen belangrijke onderwerpen. De bijlagen verbinden die vragen met onder meer Utopia, Schopenhauer, Karel van het Reve en Nabokovs lezing van Cervantes. Jeroen en Sybrand Buve verzorgden de uitgave van deze filosofische en literair-historische opstellen.
entries.identityNotes: Publisher catalogue p.22 confirms contents; Bibliotheek.nl exact ISBN 9789079378111 confirms posthumous editing by Jeroen and Sybrand Buve. Distinguishes collection from a single 1985 essay.

entries.title: Revolting Recipes
entries.author: Roald Dahl
entries.text: The imaginary foods in Roald Dahl's stories become the starting point for a playful cookbook. Revolting Recipes draws on books including Charlie and the Chocolate Factory and James and the Giant Peach, turning their unusual dishes into recipes readers can try making. Felicity Dahl and Josie Fison contribute to the collection, with illustrations by Quentin Blake. The appeal is in bringing the strange food of Dahl's fictional worlds into the kitchen through practical, step-by-step instructions.
entries.identityNotes: Publisher verifies cookbook, story inspirations and contributors. Work-level premise for selected Demco reprint ISBN; no invented pagination, binding or edition extras.

entries.title: Highland Wolf
entries.author: Hannah Howell
entries.text: Annora MacKay stays at Dunncraig Keep because she cares about the little girl living under her cruel cousin's authority. A visiting woodcarver changes the situation: James Drummond has entered the castle in disguise to recover his child, his lands and his reputation. Their attraction complicates a plan already shaped by danger and mistrust. Highland Wolf is a historical romance in Hannah Howell's Murray novels, bringing a struggle for justice together with an unexpected relationship.
entries.identityNotes: Publisher lists exact selected 9781420142662 and verifies Annora, James, disguise and The Murrays series. Not the different Highland Wolf by Lynsay Sands.

entries.title: The Anarchist Handbook
entries.author: Michael Malice
entries.text: Michael Malice brings together writings from different strands of anarchist thought, allowing conflicting ideas about freedom and authority to sit alongside one another. The Anarchist Handbook is a collection of political essays rather than a single continuous argument by its compiler. Its historical voices include Max Stirner, Josiah Warren and Mikhail Bakunin. The selection gives readers a way to compare differing views of the state, individual liberty and the forms a society without government might take.
entries.identityNotes: Exact ISBN 9798748719629 publisher-supplied Google Books record and contents; author's official books page corroborates essay collection. Distinguish compiler from authors; no operational claims or instructions.

entries.title: Plant Witchery
entries.author: Juliet Diaz
entries.text: Juliet Diaz presents plants through the traditions and beliefs of her spiritual practice. Plant Witchery combines profiles of two hundred herbs, flowers, trees and fruits with rituals, seasonal observations and exercises intended to deepen a reader's connection with nature. Its subjects include the symbolic uses of plants, ancestral traditions and the role of lunar cycles in the author's approach. The book is aimed at readers interested in plant-based spirituality and contemporary witchcraft.
entries.identityNotes: Publisher synopsis and official PRH Gift Books 2021 catalogue confirm selected hardcover ISBN 9781401960209. Attributes magical and healing concepts to spiritual beliefs; no medical efficacy or ingestion advice asserted.

entries.title: The Spanish Billionaire's Pregnant Wife
entries.author: Lynne Graham
entries.text: Molly works as a waitress when an encounter with wealthy Leandro changes the direction of her life. An unexpected pregnancy leads him to insist on marriage, bringing her into his privileged world in Spain. Molly agrees to an arrangement that is meant to exist in name only, but attraction makes that boundary difficult to maintain. Lynne Graham's contemporary romance centres on the tension between family expectations, an unequal social position and feelings neither partner can neatly control.
entries.identityNotes: Publisher synopsis verifies Molly, Leandro, pregnancy and marriage in Spain. Work-level text for selected UK library hardcover 9780263207118; no assertion of ebook release date or extra content.
